thread:
Ravi (Support): flagging an urgent escalation for Acme trial — post-IdP metadata rotation their SSO is failing. ~40% of seats can’t sign in. Renewal in 2 weeks, customer is getting anxious. Need CS to own comms and enablement ASAP :warning:
Ava (CS): on it. can you paste the error and any repro steps? I’ll draft an outreach and schedule a bridging call with enablement.
Ravi (Support): repro steps: user hits company.myapp.com -> redirect to IdP -> returns SAML response -> we return 401 invalid_signature. Seen across both staging and prod. Attached logs and SAML response (redacted) below.
Ravi (Support): ```
RequestID: a1b2c3
SAMLStatus: RequestDenied
Error: invalid_signature
IdP: https://idp.acme.com/metadata (rotated 04/10)
```
Jamie (SE): we saw the same failure pattern with Azure AD when metadata endpoint switched to RSA SHA256 only. customer may need updated SP cert or for us to accept new signing alg. quick check: do they use signed assertions or signed responses?
Ravi (Support): signed assertions. I also confirmed they rotated certs yesterday.
Ava (CS): ok — CS plan: 1) Immediate customer note acknowledging outage + ETA for next update. 2) Schedule 30m troubleshooting call with their IdP admin + our SE. 3) If fix requires config change, provide step-by-step rollback & temp workaround so users can sign in. 4) Capture feedback & impact for renewal conversation. Draft below.
Ava (CS): outreach draft (please review):
```
Hi <Name>,
We’re sorry for the SSO disruption you’ve experienced since yesterday. Our team is actively investigating; initial findings indicate a signing certificate mismatch after your IdP metadata rotation. We’re mobilizing a joint troubleshooting call with our SEs and your IdP admin to resolve this quickly.
Can you confirm the IdP contact and availability in the next 2 hours? We’ll share an interim workaround to reduce sign-in friction in the meantime.
Regards,
Ava — Customer Success
```
Oliver (Infra): tagging infra — if we need to relax assertion signature validation for a short window we can deploy a targeted patch to prod that accepts both certs, but need SE signoff and an ops runbook.
support-bot: created incident INC-2026-0453 and paged oncall.
Jamie (SE): I can join the call and walk the IdP through uploading the old cert or switching to the current signing alg. Also can prepare a temporary SP cert for them to test.
Ava (CS): plan of action agreed: Ava will send the message above in 20m, schedule a call for 30m, Jamie will join, Oliver will prepare ops runbook for a 2-hour mitigation window, Ravi continue to stream logs into the ticket. Oliver — please confirm runbook by +15.
Oliver (Infra): confirmed, will post runbook to the incident and tag here. If we need to flip validation we’ll coordinate an hour maintenance window and patch rollback steps.
Ravi (Support): I’ve attached the redacted SAML response and the IdP contact details to INC-2026-0453. Also added the list of affected user emails (anonymized).
Ava (CS): capturing next steps: outreach sent (by me) at T+20, bridging call scheduled, enablement deliverables: step-by-step rollback doc, user-impact summary for renewal team, and a quick feedback note to log sentiment. @renewals — FYI we’ll surface the impact ASAP.
Jamie (SE): one more note — if they prefer we can do an in-session cert swap with remote guidance (fastest). I’ll add a short checklist to the incident.
Ava (CS): thanks everyone. I’ll post the customer-facing message and follow up with a tracker in the incident. :thumbsup:
